items.text: 1. Fix the high rate of routing ambiguity (40 cases) in the modelunits system, as this prevents reliable instruction following for the majority of tasks.
2. Address the 86 span misses in the stagedabs module, which indicates a critical failure in extracting or processing the necessary data spans for problem solving.
3. Resolve the 106 store execution failures in mapstore, as these direct failures prevent the system from successfully completing basic bookkeeping operations.
4. Improve the model's ability to generalize templates, evidenced by the 3 refusals to generalize in the olmoe-1b model and the low generalization rate (2/11 hits) for that model.
5. Fix the 4 unclosed graphs in the aimethink module, as this structural error likely contributes to the low success rate of running graph-based reasoning steps.

record_gaps.staged_coherence: span-at-a-time absorption fragments cross-sentence relations (9/20 against 16/20 one-shot)
